Running Python code interactively: import struct
data = open('/tmp/testcase.exr','rb').read()
off = 76
attrs = {}
while True:
    end = data.index(b'\x00', off)
    name = data[off:end].decode()
    off = end+1
    if name == '':
        break
    end = data.index(b'\x00', off)
    typ = data[off:end].decode()
    off = end+1
    size = struct.unpack('<I', data[off:off+4])[0]
    off += 4
    val = data[off:off+size]
    off += size
    attrs[name] = (typ, val)
    print(f"attr {name!r} type={typ!r} size={size} val={val.hex()}")
print("offset after header:", off)
print("total len:", len(data))
print("chunk data:", data[off:].hex())
